name: School Love! 2 ~Koi Suru Parfaittic~
original_name: すくぅ～るらぶっ！2～恋するパフェちっく～
source:
The main character is Haru, who has a secret magic power. But it has a side effect. It causes pain to his brain, if he uses it. One day, his father, who also has the power, tells him that Haru needs to let someone reliable know the presence of his power within a month. Otherwise, his side effect will get worse to death. What will happen to him...?

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090717021021/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1006383]ErogeShop.com[/url]]
translation:
主人公阿倍晴拥有一项不为人知的魔力，却伴随着棘手的副作用——一旦动用这份力量，大脑便会剧痛难忍。某天，同样身怀这种能力的父亲告诫他：必须在一个月之内找到一位值得信赖的人，向对方坦白自己拥有魔力的秘密；否则副作用将不断恶化，最终危及性命。等待着他的究竟会是怎样的命运……？
